close_reason: Fixed: apply_jmap_patch() added to MemoryBackend, handles /path-style keys. All 76 tests pass.
description: MemoryBackend::update_object implements RFC 7396 flat merge-patch only, treating every patch key as a top-level JSON field. JMAP (RFC 8620 §5.3) uses path-style patch keys like 'mailboxIds/abc123'. When the Mailbox/set cascade (onDestroyRemoveEmails=true) calls update_object::<Email> with patch key 'mailboxIds/<id>': null, the MemoryBackend looks for a top-level key literally named 'mailboxIds/abc123', finds none, and silently no-ops. The email stays in its mailboxes. Integration tests for this path therefore pass without actually exercising the cascade. Any Email/set update that uses 'keywords/$flagged' or 'mailboxIds/someId' path syntax has the same problem.
title: MemoryBackend update_object: flat merge-patch breaks JMAP path-key patches
